name: Banner
description: Full-width banner with a background image and an overlaid title bar. Supports a dark variant.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Highlight a page or section with a wide image and a colored title bar overlaid at the bottom.

contentPattern.structure: Two rows: the first holds the background image (picture), the second holds the title text.

variants.name: Banner (Dark)
variants.description: Banner with a dark title bar instead of the default blue.
